newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers mixed, tight in Hamburg, Fos.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers mixed, tight in Hamburg, Fos.

text.p: European bunker prices were mixed on Thursday, with shortages in Germany and southern France sending prices higher while the Med softened, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $94/$95 fob, about $1 higher than on Wednesday, in very thin trading. The rise came after a slight increase of barge market prices.
Total ARA demand was again at around 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg fuel oil prices reached the $100 a tonne mark as shortages persisted. Suppliers said one of the majors appeared to have sold out.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers mostly dipped by $1 a tonne, while gas oil quotes rose. However, in southern France, fuel oil prices jumped by about $2 with some tightness.
"One supplier is out of 380 (CST), although it should be OK next week. We have also been a bit slow to follow ARA prices higher," one dealer said.
Most Med ports were relatively quiet.
